1.consolidated_definition: Tenacilla de metal asida a un alambre eléctrico usada para acortar circuitos temporalmente. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Este cargador funciona con 2 pilas y 3 pilas . Incluye cargador y clips tipo conector/alligator o cocodrilo (Virtual Village, consultado 06-09-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Metal clip attached to an electrical wire used to temporarily shorten circuits. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. This charger functions with 2 batteries and 3 batteries. It includes a charger and clips of the type connector/alligator or crocodile (Virtual Village, consulted on 06-09-08)
